Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 133. Category: technique. Rank 2.

Rank 2 Weapon technique
Ki Cost: 10 ki per plus 1
Casting Prerequisite: 1 Simple or Martial Weapon
that you are proficient with.
Casting Time: 1 Bonus Action
Range: Self
Duration: Upkeep
Chargeable: No
You funnel your energy into your held weapon to
empower it. For each 10 ki you spend casting this
technique, to a maximum of 30 ki, your equipped
weapon gains a +1 to attack and damage rolls.
Due to the nature of Temper, it can not currently be
mastered.
